content.title: What is Ramadan? It is simply a holy month that is known as a period of fasting and spiritual growth. We train ourselves to be better people by refraining from bad habits and self-desires like food, water and intimacy. Including bad habits like gossiping and use of slur. Then we celebrate the completion of Ramadan fasting after one month with Eid.  Ramadan is also one of the five pillars of Islam. #ramadankareem #tarikbelasri #ramadan #morocco #tarik_belasri #whatisramadan #holymonth | Tarik Belasri | Facebook
